events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years Since His Death
events.blurb: Rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Thirty years ago today, the music world lost a legend. We're remembering Tupac Shakur and his incredible impact on hip-hop. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: Remembering the Guitar Legend
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who left us on this day in 1970. His guitar work changed everything. What's your go-to Hendrix track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history! What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The voice of The Pretenders, still rocking after all these years. What's your favourite Pretenders song?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing that rock'n'roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Album Released 55 Years Ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released the timeless album 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today. What does the song 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: The Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Original iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Can you believe it's been 25 years since the first iPod dropped? It changed how we listened to music forever. Did you have one of the originals?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, 007 always delivers. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best Bond song?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the comedy legend, John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us so many unforgettable laughs. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles delivered their eclectic 'White Album'. A double album packed with incredible diversity. Which track is your absolute favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, 35 Years On
events.blurb: Queen's legendary frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' changed the game. An album that marked a new direction for the band. What's your top track from it?

events.title: John Lennon: 46 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: Musician and activist John Lennon was tragically shot and killed on this day in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world fell silent as we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace live on. What's his most impactful song for you?
